_examples.__comment: Templates for future robot-side MCP server integration. mcpServers is the only field Claude Code reads; everything under _examples is inert documentation. When your server is ready, copy an entry into mcpServers and rename the key (e.g. 'robot-diag'). See CLAUDE.md > MCP tools (robot-side) for the full pattern.

robot-diag-stdio.__comment: stdio over SSH — no port exposure, uses your existing SSH auth.

robot-diag-http.__comment: HTTP transport — faster than stdio-over-SSH; requires port + auth scheme.
